meta.name: product-hunt-launch
meta.description: Product Hunt launch optimization with specific specs, timing, and gallery strategy. Covers taglines, gallery images, maker comments, and launch day tactics. Use for: product launches, startup launches, side project launches, Product Hunt optimization. Triggers: product hunt, ph launch, product hunt launch, launch strategy, product launch, startup launch, product hunt tips, product hunt gallery, ph optimization, launch day, product hunt maker

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化产品在 Product Hunt 的发布策略与效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正准备在 Product Hunt 上发布产品并希望获得更多曝光。
copy.tagline_en: Optimize your Product Hunt launch strategy and results.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are preparing to launch a product on Product Hunt and want more visibility.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你优化 Product Hunt 产品发布流程，包括生成画廊图片、研究竞品、撰写标签语和制作者评论，并提供发布日行动清单。
howto.when: 当你提到“product hunt”、“PH launch”、“launch strategy”等关键词，或要求制定产品发布策略时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一张 Product Hunt 画廊的封面图。
为我的新产品写一条 60 字符以内的标签语。
say.note: Claude 会遵循标签语公式和字符限制生成建议。

say.text: 研究本周 Product Hunt 上类似产品的发布情况。
say.note: Claude 会调用搜索工具分析竞品发布策略。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps optimize your Product Hunt launch: generate gallery images, research competitors, craft taglines and maker comments, and provides a launch day playbook.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "product hunt", "PH launch", "launch strategy", or ask for product launch planning.

say_en.text: Generate a hero image for my Product Hunt gallery.
say_en.note: Claude will call an image generation tool to create a 1270x760 px image.

say_en.text: Write a tagline under 60 characters for my new product.
say_en.note: Claude will follow tagline formulas and character limit.

say_en.text: Research similar product launches on Product Hunt this week.
say_en.note: Claude will use search tools to analyze competitor launches.
